title: Erasing the Wrong Thing: Conditional Attribute Leakage and Concept Erasure in Shared Foundation-Model Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2611.25640v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical-image embeddings are increasingly shared in place of raw images for authorized downstream tasks, yet they may reveal sensitive attributes. Standard concept-erasure methods target population-level guardedness. However, we prove that, when binary task and sensitive labels are associated, global and task-conditional linear guardedness cannot both hold while a nonzero linear task signal is preserved, so global erasure must either eliminate that signal or retain task-conditional linear leakage. We further show how global erasure affects linear readers' discrimination between positive and negative samples with different sensitive attributes, deriving an approximate closed-form prediction of its utility cost from pre-erasure statistics. Motivated by this conflict, we introduce Task-Conditional LEACE (TC-LEACE), a closed-form variant of LEACE that enforces linear guardedness within each task stratum of its fitting data. translated_title: 擦除错的对象：共享基础模型嵌入中的条件属性泄露与概念擦除
translated_abstract: 医学图像嵌入越来越多地被共享用于授权的下游任务，以替代原始图像，然而它们可能会泄露敏感属性。标准的概念擦除方法针对的是总体层面的防护性。然而，我们证明，当二元任务标签与敏感标签相关联时，全局防护性和任务条件防护性无法在保留非零线性任务信号的情况下同时成立，因此全局擦除必须要么消除该任务信号，要么保留任务条件的线性泄露。我们进一步展示了全局擦除如何影响线性读取器对具有不同敏感属性的正负样本的判别能力，并从擦除前的统计数据推导出其效用代价的近似闭式预测。受这一冲突的启发，我们提出了任务条件LEACE（TC-LEACE），这是LEACE的一个闭式变体，它在其拟合数据的每个任务层级内强制实施线性防护性。
tldr: 论文证明了当任务标签与敏感属性相关时，全局概念擦除方法必然保留任务条件的线性属性泄露，并提出闭式方法TC-LEACE，在每个任务层级内强制实施线性防护以消除条件性敏感属性泄露。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that global concept erasure inevitably retains task-conditional linear attribute leakage when task and sensitive labels are correlated, and proposes TC-LEACE, a closed-form method that enforces linear guardedness within each task stratum to eliminate conditional sensitive-attribute leakage.
